players.product: Advantage2 annealing quantum computers and dual-rail superconducting gate-model systems (Quantum Circuits)

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Alan Baratz: during the quarter D-Wave was selected to receive approximately $1.57 million from the U.S. National Science Foundation through its National Quantum Virtual Laboratory (NQVL) program, funding its participation in the ERASE project, which develops foundational technologies for fault-tolerant quantum computing (current phase expected to span two years, including hardware system design for fault-tolerant gate-model quantum computers; successful completion could open a third, larger phase). D-Wave was also awarded second-year NQVL funding for its SQ Fab project (improved materials for superconducting qubits with scalable fabrication), one of four programs selected for continued funding after meeting first-year milestones.
